text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Nintendo Wii was released in 2006 and introduced motion-based controls through the Wii Remote. The system focused on accessibility and expanded gaming audiences beyond traditional players. It maintained backward compatibility with Nintendo GameCube games and accessories while introducing new control methods for sports, fitness, and traditional games. Its library included Wii Sports, Super Mario Galaxy, The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, Mario Kart Wii, Metroid Prime 3, and Xenoblade Chronicles. The Wii became one of Nintendo's best-selling consoles and demonstrated the popularity of motion-controlled gaming.
